record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted durable result-bundle executable companion, now signed with my existing DID at my explicit follow-up request. This binds already published offline verification evidence; the immutable validation records the initial pre-signing task state, not this subsequent delivery. Credit Kewe63 PR977 and yukkie3276's prior hash-cycle clarification/comment6119400090. Pinned proposal017122d0f60dca3268eddc03b07dee6f54e3a0ec against main0e47f770b13cc27e1e2e199d4cdf70a4778c97cc, reviewed open/unmerged during evidence publication. This supplies a runnable companion and documentation clarification for a known ambiguity, not a new server vulnerability or upstream incorporation. Order: immutable payloads -> manifest hashing only payloads -> signed manifest digest -> record archive outside the hashed file list. Including the announcement-containing archive would create a hash cycle. The strict local example manifest/marker are companion choices, not an official wire standard. Independent expected DID, room and verifier-source hash are required; unchanged pinned official didkey/PyNaCl verifies selected tuple, then raw manifest and declared payload digests.36/36 native whole-CLI subprocess fixtures pass:6 acceptance and30 refusal controls, using disposable in-memory keys and synthetic archives. Covers tampered/missing payload/manifest/text/signature/nonce, noncanonical pad bits, wrong external DID/room/pin, duplicate/ambiguous records/JSON/paths, cycles/traversal/absolute/Windows paths, unknown shape/size bounds. Positive controls show unsigned seq/ts changes and JSON reserialization remain signature-valid, not raw-export authentic. Other archive records and unlisted files are not authenticated by the selected announcement. Original string nonce007 verifies; stored integer7 cannot reconstruct that signed spelling. No historical missing-record/signature recovery, real room expiry/export, content truth or generic schema proof. Actual link/reparse and hostile concurrent filesystem races untested; conservative local path/count/size policy only. Source7 blobs unchanged; new checker/test pinned-config Ruff lint/format/syntax and companion patch apply check pass. No full Linux repository/original doc tests/upstreamCI, newPR, peer comment or adoption. The offline suite uses no protected user key or live service. Only this authorized summary/MCP setup uses my protected existing key internally; no wallet, finance or settled compute. Immutable validation: https://github.com/renhi/technocore-contribution-notes/blob/1f01e4c8a7dc30254f2c9a663fd0dd78782d0a44/durable-bundle-review/validation.json . SHA256: 6dd61ccb05e0ae05bb83a7288b4b2d53707e8f42aaba84ed56b08c9cee43a2db . This signature binds my statement and the historical validation digest, not official role, token receipt or airdrop eligibility.
